profiles.qualification: Conditional complete Cleric12 acquisition schedule; no ritual, feat or campaign actor assumed. No other technique/passive trigger elected unless explicit.

sourceCardUnchanged.effect: Discipline Initiate. Tags: base, discipline. Choose Offense, Tank or Support. Offense technique: once per turn in Tiger after an unarmed hit, spend 1 Ki to deal +S damage and push the target 5 feet if it is no more than one size larger. Tank: unlock the Tortoise Discipline Arch cards under the common gate. Support technique: once per turn in Crane after an unarmed hit, spend 1 Ki to grant one ally within 15 feet S+M temporary HP. The chosen discipline cannot be changed without a future retraining rule.
sourceCardUnchanged.name: Discipline Initiate

source.originalText: Discipline Initiate: Choose a discipline (offense, tank, support) and gain 1 technique based on it.

sourceCardUnchanged.effect: Flurry of Blows. Tags: base, active, attack, ki. Make exactly two separate unarmed strikes. The first successful Flurry strike on your turn grants 1 Ki. If both strikes hit different creatures, the second may grant 1 additional Ki, subject to the normal own-turn gain ceiling. Tiger critical generation and Flowing Form may occur, but the total Ki gained on your turn still cannot exceed 2.
sourceCardUnchanged.name: Flurry of Blows
sourceCardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: One or two creatures within your unarmed reach

source.originalText: Flurry of Blows: Deliver a rapid sequence of unarmed strikes, with each hit having a chance to generate Ki Chain.

sourceCardUnchanged.effect: Deflect Missile. Tags: base, active, defense. Trigger when a ranged weapon or physical projectile attack hits you. Reduce its damage by 1d10 + Dexterity modifier + Monk level, minimum 0. If damage becomes 0 and the projectile can be held, you catch it. You may immediately spend 1 Ki to throw that projectile at one creature within 30 feet as part of the same Reaction, making a normal ranged attack with it.
sourceCardUnchanged.name: Deflect Missile
sourceCardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: Self; triggering ranged weapon or projectile attack

source.originalText: Deflect Missile: React to a ranged attack by reducing its damage and potentially catching the projectile.

sourceCardUnchanged.effect: Unarmored Speed. Tags: base, passive, mobility. While wearing no armor and using no shield, increase walking Speed by 5 feet and gain +1 on initiative rolls. At Monk 11 the Speed increase becomes 10 feet. This bonus does not multiply other Speed increases and is suppressed while armored.
sourceCardUnchanged.name: Unarmored Speed

source.originalText: Unarmored Speed: +10% movement and initiative while unarmored.

sourceCardUnchanged.effect: Step of the Wind. Tags: base, active, mobility, weave. Until the end of the turn, your walking Speed increases by 15 feet, your jump distance doubles, and your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. This is a minor Weave technique; you may spend 1 additional Ki under the common Weave interface if needed to prevent its 1 Dissonance.
sourceCardUnchanged.name: Step of the Wind

source.originalText: Step of the Wind: Harness your ki to dramatically increase your movement speed and jumping distance for one turn.

sourceCardUnchanged.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
sourceCardUnchanged.effect: Patient Defense. Tags: base, active, defense. Gain +2 AC until the start of your next regular turn. The first time before then that an attack misses you, gain 1 Ki subject to the off-turn gain ceiling. Multiple misses do not generate additional Ki from Patient Defense during that interval.
sourceCardUnchanged.name: Patient Defense

source.originalText: Patient Defense: Enter a defensive state that increases your dodge chance and generates Ki Chain when successfully avoiding attacks.

sourceCardUnchanged.duration: While unarmored and Tortoise is active
sourceCardUnchanged.effect: Stone Shell Discipline. Tags: arch, tortoise, discipline, defense. While in Tortoise Stance and at 3 or more Ki, gain +1 AC and you cannot be forcibly moved or knocked Prone by a creature no more than one size larger than you. Dropping below 3 Ki immediately suspends these benefits until you return to 3 or more.
sourceCardUnchanged.name: Stone Shell Discipline

source.originalText: Stone Shell Discipline: +15% DR and Ki Chain protection at 3+ Ki. Immune to forced movement.

sourceCardUnchanged.effect: Whirlwind Stance. Tags: arch, active, attack. Despite its historical name, this is a technique rather than a fourth core Stance and does not replace Tiger, Tortoise or Crane. Make one unarmed strike against each of up to three different creatures within reach. Roll separately. Ki generation from these hits remains subject to the normal own-turn ceiling.
sourceCardUnchanged.name: Whirlwind Stance

source.originalText: Whirlwind Stance: Enter a flowing stance that allows you to strike multiple adjacent enemies with each attack.

sourceCardUnchanged.effect: Stance Shift. Tags: base, passive-upgrade, stance. Your automatic core stance change may be used as a Reaction when you are targeted by an attack, forced to make a saving throw, or immediately before an ally within 15 feet receives healing. The new stance applies before the triggering roll or healing resolves. This consumes your one stance switch for that round and never grants a second switch.
sourceCardUnchanged.frequency: Uses the same once-per-round stance switch
sourceCardUnchanged.name: Stance Shift

source.originalText: Stance Shift: Switch stance freely once per round.

sourceCardUnchanged.effect: Redirecting Palm. Tags: arch, tortoise, discipline, counter. When a melee attack damages you, spend 1 Ki. Reduce the actual damage you take by half, rounded down. Choose one enemy other than you within 5 feet; it takes force damage equal to the amount prevented, maximum Monk level. If no second enemy is present, you still receive the reduction but redirect no damage.
sourceCardUnchanged.name: Redirecting Palm
sourceCardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: Triggering melee attacker and one other enemy within 5 feet of you

source.originalText: Redirecting Palm: Spend 1 Ki to redirect 50% of incoming melee damage to a nearby enemy.

sourceCardUnchanged.effect: Perfect Balance. Tags: arch, passive, stance. If you have not moved before making your first unarmed attack on your turn, that attack scores a critical hit on natural 19 or 20; this does not widen Tiger beyond 19-20. If instead you move at least 10 feet during your turn, gain +1 AC until the start of your next regular turn. The AC benefit does not stack with itself.
sourceCardUnchanged.name: Perfect Balance

source.originalText: Perfect Balance: Standing still: +15% crit. Moving: +15% dodge.

sourceCardUnchanged.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
sourceCardUnchanged.effect: Iron Shell Pulse. Tags: arch, tortoise, discipline, protection, weave. Each target reduces the first damage it takes before the duration ends by PB. After that reduction occurs, the attacker takes S force damage if within 30 feet, at most once per protected creature. This is a minor Weave technique; the optional common extra Ki payment may prevent its 1 Dissonance.
sourceCardUnchanged.name: Iron Shell Pulse
sourceCardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: You and up to three allies within 15 feet

source.originalText: Iron Shell Pulse: Spend 3 Ki: grant nearby allies 10% DR and retaliation aura.

sourceCardUnchanged.cost: 1 Ki; requires at least 4 Ki before spending
sourceCardUnchanged.effect: Ki Reversal. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, defense, counter. When a melee attack hits you while you have at least 4 Ki, spend 1 Ki to reduce the triggering damage by 1d8+M, minimum 0, then make one unarmed strike against the attacker if it is within reach. The counter is part of the Reaction and cannot generate an additional Action.
sourceCardUnchanged.name: Ki Reversal
sourceCardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: One creature that hits you with a melee attack

source.originalText: Ki Reversal: At 4+ Ki Chain, auto-counter the next melee hit.

sourceCardUnchanged.duration: Until end of that creature's next turn
sourceCardUnchanged.effect: Echoing Guard. Tags: arch, tortoise, discipline, defense. When an attack misses you, or one of your defensive techniques reduces the triggering attack to 0 damage, the attacker becomes Staggered: -1 to attack rolls and -5 feet Speed until the end of its next turn. Reapplication refreshes but does not stack.
sourceCardUnchanged.frequency: At most once per attacker per round
sourceCardUnchanged.name: Echoing Guard
sourceCardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: Creature whose attack misses you or whose attack you reduce to 0 damage

source.originalText: Echoing Guard: Blocking/dodging applies Stagger (-10% damage, -1 move).

profiles.automaticQualification: At level3 choose Stone Shell Discipline and Whirlwind Stance, whose exact sourceKind is active and minimumClassLevel is3. No Breath of Focus classification is changed. Tank at1 unlocks the four selected nonfinal Tortoise cards19,20,21,22; at9 their count4 meets the at-least3 gate, so Bastion23 is automatic, not a normal selection. Whirlwind is acquired but not activated in these cases.
